subject: Recap + confirm: token volumes, budget owner & finance sign-off
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Li <jordan.li@acmerobotics.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-18 09:12 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + 2 asks (token targets + who signs)

Jordan — thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and two asks to keep momentum: 

Call highlights:
- Primary workload: customer-facing assistants + nightly batch embedding refresh for search
- Expected steady-state usage: ~3M tokens/month (inference + context)
- Peak/spike pattern: up to ~10–12M tokens in launch weeks 
- Latency SLOs: p50 <= 150ms for short-turn generation, p90 <= 400ms

Pricing note we discussed: you said finance is sensitive to unit economics and would prefer a target <$500 per 1M tokens if possible on the committed SKU. You also mentioned openness to a blended reserved+burst commit to get there.

Two asks to move fast: 
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer / who signs (name + email)? we need the right person for contracting and finance approvals.
2) Confirm the budget range you have in mind for the first 12 months (ballpark is fine) so I can model committed tiers and a $/1M token price.

Attached: redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx (draft ranges) and a 1-page MAP I can update once we lock buyer + budget.

If easier, happy to jump on a 15-min follow-up tomorrow.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0199
From: Jordan Li <jordan.li@acmerobotics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tina Ramos <procure@acmerobotics.com>
Date: 2026-05-18 10:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + 2 asks (token targets + who signs)

Thanks for the clear recap, Soojin — that matches our notes. Answers below: 

1) Economic buyer / signer: Miguel Ortiz, VP Finance — miguel.ortiz@acmerobotics.com. He owns vendor spend >$50k ARR. I'll introduce him once we have a proposed price/commit.

2) Budget range (first 12 months): planning for $200k–$350k net new ARR for this initiative (we're flexible if unit economics improve). To convert to tokens, think baseline ~3M tokens/mo steady => ~36M tokens/yr; launch spikes could push that to ~60–80M tokens in year one depending on pilot success.

On price: Miguel will push for ~$450–$500 per 1M tokens for the committed portion. We discussed preferring a blended rate: lower committed rate with a higher metered overage.

Procurement (Tina) is cc'd — Tina, are there supplier questionnaires or vendor forms we should complete before legal?

Jordan
Jordan Li | Head of ML Platforms, Acme Robotics
jordan.li@acmerobotics.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-18 11:05 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick recap + 2 asks (token targets + who signs) — pricing playbook

On Tue, May 18, 2026 at 10:03 AM Jordan Li <jordan.li@acmerobotics.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the clear recap, Soojin — that matches our notes. Answers below:
> 
> 1) Economic buyer / signer: Miguel Ortiz, VP Finance — miguel.ortiz@acmerobotics.com. He owns vendor spend >$50k ARR.
> 
> 2) Budget range (first 12 months): planning for $200k–$350k net new ARR ...

Connor — Simon wants us to hold margin but be competitive here. Based on the volumes Jordan quoted (36M baseline, 60–80M with spike), we can structure: 
- Option A: 6M tokens/month commit (72M/yr) at $475 / 1M with 10% overage discount on metered spikes
- Option B: 3M tokens/month commit (36M/yr) at $525 / 1M + burst pool pricing (gives them headroom for launch spikes)

We can stretch to $450 / 1M if they commit to a 12-month reserved seat or Dedicated pool (that lifts unit costs for us). Need confirmation which product (Hosted vs Dedicated) they prefer — recall they care about latency.

Action items:
- Soojin: secure Miguel's confirmation that finance will accept a $475 target for a 72M commit (or state firm upper $/1M they require).
- Connor: be ready to propose Dedicated capacity delta and estimate incremental cost if they want Dedicated for launch.
- I'll draft an abbreviated pricing comparison and update the MAP once buyer + target price confirmed.

— Rachel
Rachel Kim | Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Tina Ramos <procure@acmerobotics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Li <jordan.li@acmerobotics.com>
Date: 2026-05-18 12:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + 2 asks (token targets + who signs) — procurement notes

Soojin / Jordan — procurement here. A few items to expedite: 
- Please complete the attached vendor questionnaire (acme-vendor-questionnaire.pdf) and provide SOC 2 Type II report copy (or SOC self-attestation) for legal review.
- PO process: Acme issues a PO after SOW + pricing agreed and after finance signs off. We aim to get contracts to legal by 05/25; final sign by 06/01 if no major redlines.
- Finance approver: Miguel Ortiz (cc'd via Jordan). Miguel will need a simple one-pager showing committed tokens, $/1M, and annual cost estimate.

Forwarding to Miguel will help — Jordan please introduce.

Thanks,
Tina Ramos | Procurement Manager, Acme Robotics
procure@acmerobotics.com
(attachment: acme-vendor-questionnaire.pdf)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Li <jordan.li@acmerobotics.com>, Tina Ramos <procure@acmerobotics.com>
Date: 2026-05-18 14:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + 2 asks (token targets + who signs) — next steps

Thanks all — quick follow-up and plan: 
1) Jordan — can you introduce Miguel on thread today (we'll send the 1-page cost summary plus the MAP)?
2) Rachel — I'll capture the two options (A: 72M @ $475 / 1M; B: 36M @ $525 / 1M + burst) in the MAP and attach the redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx.
3) Connor — please prepare a rough Dedicated delta estimate in case they want to lock latency with Dedicated for launch.

Proposed timing: internal prep today; 15-min intro call with Miguel + Jordan + Tina + us tomorrow 10:00am PT — I’ll send a calendar invite once Miguel is on thread.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-v1.docx, redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx

— Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
